days.title: Dunes and Coastal Forest Exploration
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: sistema dunale
stops.detail: The park is densely wooded and protected from sea winds by a continuous dune system, very well formed and preserved, with an average height of about five meters and isolated peaks of over ten meters.

stops.name: arenile
stops.detail: The main activity carried out in the park is bathing, concentrated in the period from June to September and essentially located on the sandy shore.

stops.name: villa dei Cavalleggeri
stops.detail: In recent years the municipality has also acquired formal ownership of almost the entire park, with the sole exception of the villa dei Cavalleggeri and some surrounding lands.

stops.name: sentieri
stops.detail: The park is crossed transversally along paths that lead from the provincial road to the beach.
